name: Sovcombank
verdict: Sovcombank's principal shareholder is IJSC Sovco Capital Partners, the private co-owners' holding company, with 71.6%; the bank is listed on the Moscow Exchange. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: none (2026-10-03). Official bank of HC Severstal per the club's partners page. No state control: the bank's July 2024 disclosure grouped 'sovereign funds of the Russian Federation, the Middle East and Asia' at 6.7% in aggregate, with no individual sovereign fund among the disclosed 5%+ holders; after later placements Sovco Capital Partners stands at 71.6% (Interfax, 2025-07-18). Sovcombank is under US/UK/EU sanctions, a financial record that doesn't count under METHOD.md. No court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the bank found (searched 2026-10-03).
